title: Register of Filing Windows Carried by the Ridgecrest Advantage Plans
content:
Three filing windows are carried by every Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan, and their length is fixed by the plan held.

| Plan | Reconsideration filing window after the adverse determination notice (calendar days) | Additional days a late reconsideration may be accepted for on good cause (calendar days) | Provider claim filing window after the date of service (calendar days) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Value (HMO) | 60 | 30 | 365 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO) | 60 | 30 | 365 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS) | 60 | 30 | 365 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO) | 60 | 30 | 365 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO) | 60 | 30 | 365 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) | 60 | 45 | 365 |

The reconsideration filing window is the calendar days after the adverse determination notice within which a reconsideration may be filed. The good-cause figure is the additional calendar days a late reconsideration may be accepted for where good cause is shown. The provider claim filing window is the calendar days after the date of service within which a provider claim must reach the plan.

Of the three figures, only the good-cause figure moves with the plan: it stands at 45 calendar days on Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) and at 30 calendar days on the other five plans. The filing window of 60 calendar days and the provider claim window of 365 calendar days are the same on all six.
